notes.title: Numerous known issues fixed! - Patch notes v1.2
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Today update v1.2 went live! Mostly, this fixes some known issues and UI. Check out the notes here!


Horde Mode: 'Character Select' and 'Stage Select' menu now close correctly
Resized the font used for non-Roman alphabets, as it was often displaying too large
The cursor no longer automatically highlights the first row
Horde Mode: 'Main Menu' button no longer inaccessible with controller after going game over
Numerous in-game bugfixes

Go check it out in-game, let us know what you think!

-Marten

notes.title: New Horde Mode maps & Scoring System! - Patch notes v1.1
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Today we have a new update for Dog Duty: v1.1! Find the full patch notes below

Horde mode (leaving beta!)

2 new Horde Mode stages to play: River & Swamp! Which makes for 3 total stages

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29137388/00b7e7962ab12cc747f6d08315c874922ae752aa.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29137388/a816bee74f8fccb1400e27e4e22f15756835b62c.png

Added scoring system to track your stats
Tweaks on adaptive challenge, and challenge overall
Fixed some issues on shop screen

General

Vehicles may now be controlled as "tank mode", using the game controller's d-pad
Enemy A.I tweaked to work better on specific cases
Swamp Depot 1 changed to make better use of space and gameplay fluidity

Let us know what you think of this update and have fun!

-Marten

notes.title: Controller updates & Horde mode fixes - Patch notes v0.995
notes.notes:
Hi all!

Update v0.995 has gone live and it brings quite some nice controller updates and of course more updates for Horde Mode! Check it all out below

General

Fixed issue blocking player progression on Swamp Depot I
Dpad icons are now displayed more clear
Dpad buttons now function in menu button selection
Added target-snapping to gamepad-mode
Dualshock 4 button icons now displayed, if player uses a Dualshock


Horde Mode

-Marten

notes.title: Post Processing & Boss fight in Horde mode - Patch notes v0.994
notes.notes:
Hi all!

Another patch dropped, and this one brings things like post processing effects, a boss fight to horde mode and AI fixes! Check out the full patch notes below


Added post processing effects to increase graphical quality. This can be turned on and off in the main menu options
Boss fight added for the end of Horde Mode
Fixed AI issues in Horde Mode
Changed the Shop UI in Horde Mode
Shop in Horde Mode now works correctly for gamepad players
Fixed the stuck animations of Otto in both campaign and Horde Mode
Tweaks for balancing enemy strengths and presence in Horde Mode
You may now select characters for your squad before starting in Horde Mode

Of course as always, let me know what you think in the comments, or open a discussion topic in the Steam Community Hub :D

-Marten

notes.title: Horde Mode additions! - Patch notes v0.993
notes.notes:
Hey all!

As Horde Mode recently made it into Dog Duty, there's been some new stuff that's been added into the game for this new game mode. Check it out:


Added BotPods for automated defense
Added 2 new turret modules: Hydra Rockets and Artillery
Fixed issue that prevented placement of objects on certain tiles
Squad now is automatically healed after wave complete
Fixed an odd issue that blocked gamepad input on some certain conditions


Right now the developers are working on the shop screen when playing with a game pad, as right now we're aware that it looks quite messy ;)

Enjoy!

-Marten

notes.title: New enemies & updated explosions - Patch notes v0.99
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

There's a brand new update live that brings something a lot of you requested in reviews, more variation in enemies, updated explosions and new soundtracks! There is now more variation in enemies you'll encounter in each region of the game, which spices things up quite a bit! Check out the full patch notes here:

Added a LOT of new soundtrack from Bettina Calmon!
New enemies (six in total) with different kinds of weapons. From machete soldiers to ballistic shield troops, they will challenge our heroes' pragmatic skills!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29137388/48267e7d7da1ca40dcd0506a24a73af6be978e1e.gif{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29137388/8c5d3eaa66345e3b32435ac5371c401ace98fe65.gif

Updated effects for fire and explosions
Fixed bug that prevented player vehicles from getting repairs on friendly locations
Added markers showing each hero/enemy weapon radius, that shows on the "Reality-Check Mode".
Fixed enemy odd behaviour on a specific Capital level.
Fixed parking area display on Desert Pow Camp
Removed odd tip on a particular Capital level
Fixed issue when player soldiers try to collect pickups during vehicular combat
Fixed and issue where reinforcement warning wouldn't dissapear
Fixed flag change cutscene on Swamp Boss location
Fixed odd behaviour of enemy stuck far away from player's Hovercraft

I hope you all like it! We're still very much looking for feedback, and I'd really appreciate if you guys could let me know what still can be improved on the game, especially now in terms of game balance.

Have a great day!

-Marten

notes.title: Final 3 new languages added + patch notes v0.97
notes.notes:
Hi all!

The final 3 languages were added to Dog Duty today! 

Polish (Polskie)
French (Français)
Turkish (Türk)

This means that there's now a total of 14 languages available in the game!

There's also been some difficulty tweaks in this patch. You can find those below!

The 3 main bosses in each region are now more challenging
the last capital blockade in Octopia is now less hard to defeat

That's it this time! There's still some updates to come, so stay tuned for those :)

-Marten

notes.title: 3 new languages added + patch notes v0.96
notes.notes:

Spanish (Español)
Korean (한국어)
Japanese (日本人)

Fixed ladder on Desert Pow Camp.

notes.title: 4 new languages added + patch notes v0.95

I'm glad to announce that 4 new languages have been added to Dog Duty! These are the languages:

Italian (Italiano)

notes.title: Dog Duty patch notes - v0.94
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Today I have some GREAT NEWS, because we have a big update live right now! v0.94 is now available for all of you to play, and there's some juicy stuff in there. Let's dive into it with the patch notes!

Reinforcement System Overhaul

Added a new specific soldier model to act as reinforcement, so it will be clearer which soldier is a reinforcement and which one isn't
The reinforcement vehicles are also new, and characterized as police vehicles. (New boats for swamp/river, new car for desert)
There's also been some minor tweaks like timing and other details

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29137388/db33898288eeb2795cc78c289f71d0e8c4defb4c.gif

Other new stuff

Added a new troop transport vehicle, that carries up to 8 soldiers, with the additional of a shooter on the roof or a parabomb launcher
The new Octo-Light-Tank, will be participating on some patrols in the Desert.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29137388/336e9406383153efc90be90122f008a5304e132d.gif

Lots of improvements on general game performance
Some tweaks and changes on the UI/HUD: for example, the inventory icon now is a backpack, among other changes
WASD now may be used to control vehicles on World-Mode
Corrections on the intro conversation at the Octopia gates
There's now a new "Radio-System", to help entering and exiting locations

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29137388/001e40a0f5e329ba12799690d7eb6d051352c827.gif

Chat baloons now show more lines, helping the readability of bigger text
There's now NPCs when you conquer a location. They may tell useful information... or not

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29137388/db2b0dcb546a0d7e694640e8937318cdd4e5ff09.gif

Added new loading screen to.. well, show when things are loading, of course!
The endgame animation was remade


General bugfixes

Fixed a bug where the mouse cursor would disappear when getting back to main menu
Fixed a bug where landmines would explode infinitely
Fixed a bug where some buttons would not show up properly in specific cases
Fixed a bug where the intro location was not showing as conquered location
Fixed details like opening a new game file after deleting a file and selecting a new item to buy after buying an item
Fixed an issue with scrolling through available mounted weapons in the vehicle's menu with controller


That's it for this patch, but I hope you all enjoy it because there's quite some new stuff in there! As you might've heard already, we also announced that Dog Duty is coming to Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4 and Xbox One this spring! Check out that announcement here: https://steamcommunity.com/games/578690/announcements/detail/1694979421812991362
Okay bye!

-Marten

Just dropping in here with some patch notes for the most recent patch for Dog Duty. Let's dive right in:

Changed the last level - now the player may enter Octopia, and wreck mayhem before the final encounter

notes.title: Dog Duty Patch notes v0.918
notes.notes:
Hi all!

It's been a while since we posted on here, but that doesn't mean we've been lazy! There's been two patches done before this one, so I'll add those notes in here as well. Here's the full overview!

Fixed some issues that led to stuck soldiers on the battlefield
Revision on some gameplay logic
Gameplay fixes on swamp levels
Fixed issue that prevented players from entering the Swamp Island
Added more content to  Swamp, Capital and Desert islands
Updates to make the world more lively such as toucans flying around in the swamp and more trees and buildings in swamp environments. There's also more buildings, cars, silos, trees, and potato crops on the desert island. On the river island, there's also more buildings and watchtowers added
Addressed bug regarding making a bad savegame on the final base
Added soldier dialog in several locations

For the next update, we're working on solving performance issues, bug solving and adding content that we think will improve the game for the best: a proper Octopia Capital final stage!

This new Octopia Capital will feature a new checkpoint location, a driveable field with a final car battle, and a re-worked Octopia Garden, the final location itself.

That's what we have for now but we'll be back soon with more updates!

-Marten

notes.title: Dog Duty Patch Notes - v0.914
notes.notes:
Hi all!

It's Marten here again. Dog Duty was updated and I've got some of the juicy patch notes right here! Please, keep the feedback coming, because we're looking to improve the game a lot more!

Fixed the problem of running your vehicle into breakable objects and getting stuck on rubble. Rubble will now disappear in 3 to 6 seconds.
Fixed a problem on the map mode, the UI button are back now
Fixed enemies walking against each other on swamp outpost A
Top antena on outpost b swamp is now reachable for players using gamepad (scrolling area got larger, antenna was also moved)
Flamethrower weapons was nerfed slightly
Romeo's special attack was nerfed slightly
Now every outpost, depot and pow camp have an octo-officer armed with a pistol

That's it for now, but be on the lookout for more patches coming up!

Seeya!

-Marten

notes.title: The Soundtrack Update
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29137388/2f2172754a10794548f63996950b45b810b78724.gif
In 4 years of development, Dog Duty evolved from a simple base-defense game to a simplified-open-world-guerrilla-simulator. To reinforce the current game, the Soundtrack Update is on.

There's also some things to note:

-There's a new bug report tool. Located on the MainMenu, It sends your game files to us. It's great for reporting issues with save files, and believe me, save files with issues are gold here.

-Achievements to the game! We're still testing... but they should be 100% sure working in a week of testing.

-We're working hard to finish game on July, on the max. The Final Boss is coded and fully functional, but, it's temporarily disabled, until I work on the game finishing.

There's also a lot of bug fixes and other additions.
As always, please share your opinions, thoughts and bug reports on the forums! Thank you all very, very much, on supporting Dog Duty!

notes.title: The voice update
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29137388/9af85de37024e262742ff922affec710c60019f7.jpg
There's a new update, with a lot of fixes and additions, but the most noticeable update will be on the audio.

Now Kilmer and Paula character features it's own voices. The radio effect also got some work, and we would love to hear what you guys think.

There's a test-purpose-option to enable the original audio voices, among other little things.

There's one thing that dont got into the update: the Capital, and it's Final Battle. It's taking a little longer than expected to finish, but we're taking care to script everything right (the game ending as well).

The next update, of course, will be the Capital Update, and we hope to have it done as soon as possible.

notes.title: The Mount Octopus Update
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29137388/82d556924becd1ef8d4a8a5c80b698840747d900.png
And here we are. Engaging to the game's full state. There's bugfixes, some new content here and there. And, of course, the Mount Octopus, with (almost) all of it's glory.

It's been a hard road, but we're reaching on our goal. Next, we will work to finish the Dog Duty's adventure: the 2 remaining bosses, a final boss, the final battleground (Octopus Palace), and the ending animations.

Of course, there's still some improvements here and there, and a good amount of bugs to work on. If you get upon a bug, please tell us! Bug reports are true GOLD.
